line: Welcome, welcome, welcome to the Meridian Mall! Tonight's main event: one courier, one atrium, and a whole lot of hungry neighbours.

Fine. Come in. The studio's open. Mind the step.

Echo.

Parker! Parker, you're pinned. The whole floor's on fire.

Clean.

Up you get.
